PRODUCT OVERVIEW

ES11 is an electric off-road motorcycle in the ES SERIES, combining 35 kW peak power, a 96V 50Ah battery, aluminium alloy construction and hydraulic disc brakes.

ELECTRIC DRIVE35 kW peak power and 1200 N·m maximum torque.
OFF-ROAD CHASSISAluminium alloy frame with 410 mm minimum ground clearance.
LONG-TRAVEL SUSPENSIONFront 310 mm travel; rear 120 mm shock / 250 mm wheel travel.
HYDRAULIC DISC BRAKESFront and rear hydraulic disc brakes; Front 90/90-21; rear 120/90-18.

核心亮点

MOTOR AND BATTERY

35 kW electric drive paired with a 96V 50Ah battery.

FRONT FORK

Off-road front suspension with 310 mm travel.

WHEEL ASSEMBLY

Front 90/90-21; rear 120/90-18 with an off-road wheel package.

BRAKE DISC

Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes for controlled off-road braking.
